announcement: Small tasks, made easier. MiniKit is now live.
heroLead: Convert an image, make a QR code, count your words. The handy tools you need, all in one calm place.
privacyLine: Your files stay on your device. No uploads, no account.
pickTool: What would you like to do today?
toolsTitle:
Tools that get it done.
Nothing you don’t need.
imageDesc: Convert images to WebP, JPEG or PNG, or make the file smaller.
uploadChoose: Choose an image or drop it here
fileLimit: JPG, PNG, WEBP · Up to 20 MB
qrDesc: Enter a link or short text, then download and share your QR code.
qrEmpty: Your QR code will appear here
wordDesc: Instantly check word count, character count and reading time.
localWord: Your text never leaves your device
colorDesc: Switch easily between HEX, RGB and HSL values.
whyTitle:
Focus on your task,
not finding a tool.
whyLead: You don’t need a different website for every little task. MiniKit brings the practical tools you use most together in one clear, easy place.
benefitOne: Open it, do the thing, move on. No downloads, sign-up forms or waiting.
benefitTwo: Your files and text stay on your device. We don’t store your data.
benefitThree: No confusing menus. What you need is right where it should be.
privacyTitle:
Your files get the job
done without passing through us.
privacyLead: Your images, text, QR contents and calculations are processed in your browser. Read our privacy policy for details about hosting, local storage and the current advertising status.
ctaTitle:
Make your next little task
a little easier.
ctaLead: Try your first tool now. Free, no account, no fuss.
imageTooLarge: This file exceeds the 20 MB limit.
imageConverted: Conversion complete. Your download is starting.
imageFailed: Could not convert the image. Try another format.
qrMissing: Please enter a link or some text.
qrFailed: Could not make the QR code. Try a shorter text.
copyFail: Could not copy; select and copy the value.
metaTitle: MiniKit — Free tools for everyday tasks
metaDescription: Convert images, generate QR codes, count words and convert colors. Free, fast and private.
guidePrivacyQuestion: Is my input sent to a server?
guideFormatQuestion: Which image format should I choose?
guideWebp: Small file sizes, ideal for web use.
guideJpeg: Good for photos and broad compatibility.
guidePng: Best for transparency and lossless graphics.
caseDesc: Switch text between uppercase and lowercase using the selected language's rules.
dedupeDesc: Remove repeated lines of text. Keep each first text line unchanged and in its original position. Keep only one empty line.
ignoreCase: Treat uppercase and lowercase letters as equal
trimSpaces: Ignore whitespace at the start and end of each text line when comparing
sortDesc: Sort lines using the selected language's alphabet. Numbers sort naturally: 2 before 10. Empty lines are preserved.
jsonDesc: Validate, indent or minify JSON. Large numbers and duplicate object keys are preserved as written.
jsonInvalid: Invalid JSON. Check quotes, commas and brackets.
devLimit: Limit reached: at most 100,000 input characters, 100 JSON nesting levels and 2 million output characters.
base64Desc: Convert UTF-8 text to standard Base64 and back. This is text conversion, not encryption or binary file decoding.
base64Invalid: Invalid Base64 or invalid UTF-8 text. Use standard Base64 letters, numbers, +, / and optional = padding.
urlDesc: Encode or decode one URL value using percent encoding. A + stays a + when decoded; this is not form-data conversion.
urlInvalid: Invalid percent encoding or Unicode text. Check % escapes and UTF-8 sequences.
devInputHint: Paste the text to convert here
passwordDesc: Generate a password on your device using Web Crypto. At least one character from each selected group is included. Passwords are not stored.
passwordInvalid: Choose at least one character group and a whole length from 8 to 128. Secure randomness must be available in your browser.
passwordLocal: Generated only on this device. Not saved or uploaded.
unitDesc: Convert length, mass, temperature, volume and speed. Gallons and fluid ounces use US liquid units. Results are rounded to 12 significant digits.
numberHint: Use a decimal dot or comma; no thousands separators.
unitInvalid: Check the numeric value and units. Temperature cannot be below absolute zero; the result must be finite.
percentDesc: Calculate a percentage of a value, a ratio or a percentage change. Change uses the absolute starting value; a zero baseline is undefined. Results use 12 significant digits.
percentRatio: A as a percentage of B
percentChange: Percentage change from A to B
percentInvalid: Enter valid finite numbers. B cannot be zero for a ratio; A cannot be zero for percentage change.
resizeDesc: Change image width and height in pixels, with optional aspect ratio locking. Preview and download a PNG on your device.
cropDesc: Crop using pixel coordinates measured from the top-left corner, or choose a centered square. Preview and download a PNG.
rotateDesc: Rotate clockwise by 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Optional mirroring is applied to the original image before rotation. Download a PNG.
editorLimits: JPEG, PNG or WebP; up to 20 MB, 16 million pixels and 8192 pixels per side. PNG output preserves transparency. Animated images use one frame.
editorInvalid: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP image within the limits. Use whole pixel values; the crop must stay inside the original image.
editorEmpty: Choose an image to see a preview
watermarkDesc: Add a text watermark with adjustable position, size and opacity. Preview and download as PNG.
paletteDesc: Extract up to six dominant colors from a sampled image. Copy HEX codes or download the palette.
image64Desc: Convert an original JPEG, PNG or WebP file into a data URL. Metadata is preserved; Base64 is not encryption.
watermarkHint: Up to 140 characters. Long text is fitted to the image. This is a visible watermark, not copy protection.
paletteHint: Approximate colors from a sample of up to 256 × 256 pixels. Mostly transparent pixels are ignored.
image64Limits: JPEG, PNG or WebP; up to 5 MB, 16 million pixels and 8192 pixels per side. Original bytes and metadata are retained.
imageExtraInvalid: Choose a valid supported image within the stated limits and check the settings.
imageExtraCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
imageExtraEmptyPalette: No sufficiently opaque pixels were found.
imagesPdfDesc: Combine JPEG, PNG and WebP images into one PDF. Reorder images and choose A4 or original-size pages.
mergePdfDesc: Combine the pages of multiple plain PDF files in the order you choose. Originals stay unchanged.
splitPdfDesc: Choose pages such as 1-3,5 and download them together as a new PDF. Page numbering starts at 1.
pdfImageLimits: Up to 20 JPEG/PNG/WebP images, 20 MB each and 50 MB total. Each image: up to 16 million pixels and 8192 pixels per side. Animated images use one frame.
pdfFileLimits: Up to 10 PDFs and 50 MB total; at most 200 source pages. Encrypted, signed and form PDFs are not supported. Bookmarks, attachments and document-level features are not retained; review the output.
pdfSplitLimits: One PDF up to 50 MB and 200 pages. Encrypted, signed and form PDFs are not supported. The selected pages are saved in one new PDF; document-level features are not retained.
pdfOriginal: Original image pixel dimensions as PDF points
pdfRangeHint: Example: 1-3,5. Comma-separated pages/ranges; selection order is preserved, duplicates removed. Every number must exist in the source PDF.
pdfInvalid: Check the files, limits and page selection. Only supported plain PDFs or raster images can be processed.
pdfOrder: Files are processed in the order below.
uuidDesc: Generate up to 100 random UUID v4 identifiers using your device’s Web Crypto random source.
shaDesc: Calculate the lowercase SHA-256 digest of UTF-8 text. Spaces and line breaks matter; this is not encryption or password storage.
shaHint: Up to 100,000 characters. Empty text is valid. No trimming or Unicode normalization is applied.
unixDesc: Convert Unix timestamps to UTC dates and UTC dates to timestamps. Choose seconds or milliseconds explicitly.
unixHint: All dates use UTC, not your device’s local time. Supports years 0001–9999 and negative timestamps. No scientific notation or grouping separators.
devExtraInvalid: Check the input, count, date and timestamp unit. Web Crypto requires a supported browser and secure connection.
shaSecurity: SHA-256 is a one-way digest. Do not use a plain SHA-256 hash to store passwords.
devExtraCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
replaceDesc: Replace every exact, case-sensitive occurrence of plain text. Replacement text is literal; no regular expressions.
diffDesc: Compare two texts line by line and see added, removed and unchanged lines. Case and spaces matter.
lineNumberDesc: Number each line, including empty lines. Choose a starting number and optional leading zeros.
replaceHint: Up to 100,000 input characters. Search/replacement: up to 10,000 characters. Results are limited to 1,000,000 characters.
diffHint: Up to 500 lines and 100,000 characters per text. CRLF/CR line endings are treated as LF. Differences are shown by whole lines, not individual characters.
lineHint: Up to 10,000 lines and 100,000 input characters. Line endings become LF. A final line break creates an empty last line; empty input has no lines.
textExtraInvalid: Check the search text, starting number and input/output limits. Empty search text is not allowed.
textExtraCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
ageDesc: Calculate completed years and days since the last birthday on a chosen reference date. Dates are calendar dates, without time zones.
dateDiffDesc: Count calendar days between two dates, with an optional inclusive end date. Also see whole weeks and remaining days.
countdownDesc: Count down to a date and time in your device’s local time zone. The timer follows the actual clock instead of accumulating interval drift.
ageHint: Years 0001–9999. The reference date must not precede birth. A 29 February birthday is treated as 28 February in non-leap years. This is a calendar calculation.
dateDiffHint: Calendar days, not elapsed 24-hour periods. The end date must not precede the start date. Same-day dates give 0 days, or 1 with the inclusive option.
countdownTarget: Target date and time (device local time)
countdownRunning: Countdown running. Keep this page open.
countdownStopped: Countdown stopped. Starting again recalculates time to the same target.
countdownDone: The target time has been reached.
countdownHint: Uses your device’s clock and time zone. Non-existent daylight-saving times are rejected; repeated local times use the earlier occurrence. No background notification or alarm is scheduled, and closing the page stops the timer.
dateInvalid: Choose valid dates within years 0001–9999 and check their order or the target local time.
dateCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
htmlDesc: Encode text as HTML entities or decode HTML5 character references. Results stay plain text and are never rendered as HTML.
htmlHint: Up to 100,000 input characters and 2,000,000 output characters. Decode applies once using HTML text-context rules; this is not an HTML sanitizer.
jwtDesc: Inspect the JSON header and payload of a three-part JWT locally. Encrypted five-part JWE tokens are not supported.
jwtWarning: Signature NOT verified. Decoded claims may be forged; do not use this view to authenticate users or trust a token. No key is requested and no token is uploaded.
jwtHint: Up to 100,000 token characters. Requires Base64url-encoded UTF-8 JSON objects for header and payload. Decoding does not check expiration, issuer, audience or permissions.
baseDesc: Convert signed integers between bases 2–36 without JavaScript floating-point rounding. Uses exact BigInt arithmetic.
baseHint: Up to 4,096 digits, with an optional + or − sign. Use digits 0–9 and letters a–z; no prefixes (0x/0b), fractions or grouping separators. Negative results use a minus sign, not two’s complement.
encodingInvalid: Check the HTML size, JWT structure/encoding, digits and selected bases. The input may exceed the stated limits.
encodingCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
toneDesc: Adjust brightness and contrast locally. Preview the result and download a PNG without changing the original.
grayscaleDesc: Convert a color image to grayscale using weighted luminance. Transparency and original dimensions are preserved.
avatarDesc: Center-crop an image into a circle and download a square PNG with transparent corners.
toneHint: Brightness adds up to ±255 to RGB channels. Contrast scales their distance from midpoint 128 by a factor of 0–2. Clipped highlights/shadows cannot be restored.
grayscaleHint: Produces shades of gray using weighted RGB luminance and preserves alpha transparency. No file is uploaded.
avatarHint: Uses the largest centered square of the source, clipped to a circle. Corners stay transparent in PNG; enlarging a small source does not add detail.
effectInvalid: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP within the limits and check the effect settings.
cssMinDesc: Minify a stylesheet with CSSO, with structural rule restructuring disabled. CSS is processed as text and never applied to this page.
jsonCsvDesc: Convert an array of flat JSON objects into CSV. Columns follow first-seen key order; missing values and null become empty cells.
csvJsonDesc: Convert a header-based CSV table to JSON objects. Every cell stays a string, preserving leading zeros and large integer text.
csvProtectHint: Prefixes string cells and headers beginning with =, +, − or @ (after whitespace) with an apostrophe. This changes those values; turn it off when exact text is required.
csvBom: Add a UTF-8 BOM for spreadsheet compatibility
csvRules: Up to 100,000 input and 2,000,000 output characters, 1,000 data rows, 100 columns and 10,000 data cells. CSV uses quoted fields and CRLF output. CSV input supports quoted delimiters, escaped quotes and multiline cells; rows must have equal width and headers must be nonempty and unique.
jsonCsvHint: Flat objects with string, number, boolean or null values only. Nested values, duplicate/empty keys and columnless rows are rejected. Numeric JSON spelling is retained; CSV does not preserve JSON types. All cells are quoted.
cssMinHint: Up to 100,000 input and 2,000,000 output characters. Preserves /*! important comments */. Syntax support follows CSSO; review newer CSS syntax and the output in your target browsers.
transformInvalid: Check the CSS/JSON/CSV syntax, supported data shape, delimiter, headers and stated limits.
transformCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
slugDesc: Turn a title into a readable URL slug.
slugHint: Lowercase, accents removed, punctuation replaced with hyphens. Turkish letters are supported; other scripts stay in Unicode. Up to 100,000 characters.
reverseDesc: Reverse text while keeping emoji and combined characters together.
reverseHint: Reverses the entire text by visible character groups, including line order. Requires a browser with Intl.Segmenter. Up to 100,000 characters.
whitespaceDesc: Remove extra spaces and tidy text in one step.
whitespaceHint: Collapses whitespace and trims edges. Preserve line breaks to keep internal blank lines; turn it off for a single line. Up to 100,000 characters.
utilityInvalid: Check the input limit and browser support. Invalid Unicode is not supported.
discountDesc: Calculate the sale price and how much you save.
discountHint: Price from 0 to 1 trillion; discount from 0 to 100%. Results rounded to 2 decimals, in the same currency as your input. No tax or additional fees.
proportionDesc: Find the missing value in A / B = C / D.
proportionHint: Leave exactly one field empty. B and D cannot be zero. Only a unique finite solution is accepted.
travelDesc: Find one value using the other two and your preferred units.
travelHint: Choose the value to find; its input is ignored. Uses constant average speed, without stops. Division by zero is not allowed. h = hours, min = minutes, s = seconds; mi = miles.
dailyNumberHint: Use a dot or comma for decimals, without thousands separators. Absolute input values up to 1 trillion. Proportion and travel results use up to 12 significant digits; maximum absolute result 1 quadrillion. Calculations are approximate.
dailyInvalid: Check the numbers, limits and required fields. For a proportion, leave exactly one field empty and avoid zero denominators.
readingDesc: Estimate reading time from a text and your reading speed.
readingHint: Uses browser word segmentation, 80–1,000 words/minute and rounds up to whole seconds. An estimate, not a reading assessment. Up to 100,000 characters.
frequencyDesc: Find the most frequent words in your text.
frequencyHint: Top 100 words, case-insensitive with Unicode normalization. Uses the page language for segmentation and case conversion; includes common words and numbers. Up to 100,000 characters.
pickerDesc: Choose random entries from a list, one entry per line.
pickerHint: Blank lines are ignored and edges trimmed. Select 1–100 entries from up to 10,000 lines / 100,000 characters. Lines are selected without replacement; duplicate text on different lines can repeat. Uses browser cryptographic randomness.
xmlformatDesc: Validate and indent XML locally in your browser.
xmlformatHint: Up to 100,000 characters, 10,000 nodes and 100 levels. DTDs/entities are unsupported. Mixed content and xml:space are preserved; whitespace between element-only children is reindented. Not a schema validator or byte-preserving editor.
urlparseDesc: Inspect a web address without opening it.
urlparseHint: Accepts absolute HTTP/HTTPS URLs up to 100,000 characters, without unescaped spaces. Query parameters keep duplicate entries. Credentials are omitted; encoded paths/fragments stay encoded. Nothing is fetched.
contrastDesc: Check text contrast between two opaque sRGB colors.
contrastHint: WCAG text contrast: AA normal 4.5:1 / large 3:1; AAA normal 7:1 / large 4.5:1. Large text: at least 18pt, or 14pt bold. Decisions use the unrounded ratio. Not a complete accessibility audit.
packInvalid: Check the input, options and limits. Your browser may not support this operation.
flipDesc: Mirror an image horizontally, vertically or both.
flipHint: Keeps the original dimensions and transparency. Downloads PNG; animated images use one decoded frame. Metadata is not copied.
borderDesc: Add a solid-color outer border to your image.
borderHint: Adds 0–512 pixels on each side; output dimensions grow. Original transparent pixels stay transparent. Output also obeys the image size limits. Downloads PNG without metadata.
roundedDesc: Create transparent rounded corners and download PNG.
roundedHint: Radius 0–4,096 pixels, capped at half the shorter side. Preserves dimensions and cuts corners to transparency. Animated images use one frame; metadata is not copied.
decorationInvalid: Check the image format, dimensions and settings. The resulting image must fit the size limits.
pdfrotateDesc: Rotate every page or selected pages clockwise.
pdfrotateHint: Adds 90°, 180° or 270° clockwise to existing page rotation. Select all pages or enter ranges such as 1-3,5. Output copies page content; bookmarks, attachments and document metadata are not retained. Not a PDF sanitizer.
pdfreorderDesc: Arrange PDF pages in the exact order you choose.
pdfreorderHint: Enter every page exactly once, for example 3,1-2 for a 3-page file. Missing and duplicate pages are rejected. Bookmarks, attachments and document metadata are not retained. Not a PDF sanitizer.
pdfdeleteDesc: Remove selected pages and download a new PDF.
pdfdeleteHint: Enter pages to remove, such as 1-3,5. At least one page must remain. The original file stays unchanged. Bookmarks, attachments and document metadata are not retained. Not a PDF sanitizer.
pdfEditInvalid: Check the PDF and page selection. Include every page exactly once when reordering; deletion must leave a page. Encrypted files, forms, signed documents and portfolios are unsupported.
jsonyamlDesc: Convert JSON data into readable YAML.
jsonyamlHint: Converts values, not original formatting. Duplicate JSON keys are rejected. Strings stay strings; comments and numeric spelling are not preserved.
yamljsonDesc: Convert a single YAML 1.2 document into JSON.
yamljsonHint: Supports core JSON-compatible values with string mapping keys. Anchors, aliases, merge expansion, custom tags, multiple documents and non-finite numbers are unsupported. Comments and formatting are discarded.
jsondiffDesc: Compare JSON values and list structural differences.
jsondiffHint: Object key order is ignored; array order matters. Reports added, removed and changed values using JSON Pointer paths (empty path means root). Up to 1,000 differences; no partial result on overflow.
structuredLimits: Each input: 100,000 characters, 10,000 value nodes, 100 levels. Output: 2 million characters. Integers beyond ±9,007,199,254,740,991 and numbers that would lose decimal precision are rejected.
structuredInvalid: Check syntax, duplicate keys, nesting and size limits. Unsupported YAML features or numbers that lose precision are rejected.
stopwatchDesc: Measure elapsed time with start, pause and reset.
stopwatchHint: Shows tenths of a second; maximum just under 100 hours. Continues while the tab is open. Reloading or closing the page resets it. Background updates can be delayed.
pomodoroDesc: Plan a focus session or a short break.
pomodoroHint: Focus 1–180 minutes, break 1–60 minutes. Start or pause the selected phase; completion stops the timer. Switch phases manually. Changing settings resets the timer. No sound or notifications; page reload resets it.
pomodoroDone: Time is up. Choose the next phase or restart.
chanceDesc: Flip a coin or roll a six-sided die.
chanceHint: Generates 1–100 independent draws using browser cryptographic randomness. Outcomes can repeat.
chanceInvalid: Choose a draw type and an integer count from 1 to 100.
combineDesc: Join images horizontally or vertically into one PNG.
combineHint: Choose up to 10 JPEG/PNG/WebP files, at most 20 MiB each and 50 MiB total. Reorder with arrows. Images keep their sizes, aligned top/left on transparency. Combined source and output limits: 16 million pixels and 8,192 pixels per side. Animated images use one frame; metadata is not copied.
blurDesc: Apply a soft blur and download a PNG.
blurHint: Blur radius 0–50 pixels; keeps dimensions. Edges and transparency may soften. Requires Canvas filter support. Animated images use one frame; metadata is not copied.
invertDesc: Create a color negative while keeping transparency.
invertHint: Each RGB channel becomes 255 minus its original value. Alpha and dimensions stay the same. Downloads PNG; animated images use one frame, without copied metadata.
creativeInvalid: Check file type, dimensions, size and settings. The output must fit the image limits; your browser must support the effect.
regexDesc: Test a JavaScript regular expression against text.
regexHint: JavaScript syntax; supported flags depend on your browser. Pattern up to 1,000 characters, text up to 100,000. Runs in a worker with about a 1-second timeout. Up to 1,000 matches / 2 million output characters. Indexes use UTF-16; no partial output on limit. Empty matches advance safely.
regexInvalid: Invalid pattern or flags, too many matches, or the 1-second time limit was exceeded.
htmlmdDesc: Convert basic HTML into Markdown text.
htmlmdHint: Up to 100,000 input characters / 2 million output characters. Supports headings, lists, links, quotes and code. Scripts, forms and styles are removed; images become alt text. Only absolute HTTP(S) links are retained. Tables and complex layouts may lose formatting. No resources are fetched.
mdpreviewDesc: Preview Markdown and copy the cleaned HTML.
mdpreviewHint: Up to 100,000 characters, with about a 2-second parsing timeout. Cleaned HTML is shown in an isolated preview; scripts, styles, image loads and active links are disabled. GFM tables are supported; not every HTML feature is retained.
tipcalcDesc: Add a tip and divide the total equally.
tipcalcHint: Bill 0–1 trillion; tip 0–100%; 1–1,000 people. Uses the currency of your input. Results round to 2 decimals; rounded shares may not sum exactly to the total. No added tax. Use decimal dot/comma, without thousands separators.
fuelcalcDesc: Estimate fuel used and trip cost.
fuelcalcHint: Distance 0–1 billion km, consumption 0–1,000 L/100 km, price 0–1 million per liter. Cost uses your currency, capped at 1 quadrillion. Estimate excludes tolls and other costs; no live prices. Results round to 2 decimals. Decimal dot/comma accepted, no thousands separators.
dateaddDesc: Move a calendar date forward or backward.
dateaddHint: Adds whole calendar days, including weekends. Positive and negative counts supported, up to ±3,652,058 days. Start and result must be within years 0001–9999. UTC arithmetic avoids daylight-saving shifts; result is YYYY-MM-DD.
suiteInvalid: Check the input, limits and options. This browser may not support the operation.
audiotrimDesc: Keep a selected time range and download WAV.
audiotrimHint: Enter start/end in seconds. Selection rounds to the nearest sample; end must follow start and fit the track. Output is re-encoded WAV, not a lossless copy of compressed source bytes.
audiojoinDesc: Join tracks in order into one WAV file.
audiojoinHint: Choose up to 5 tracks, then reorder with arrows. Concatenates without fades or overlaps. If any track is stereo, mono tracks are copied to both channels. Combined duration must not exceed 120 seconds.
audionormalDesc: Adjust the global peak level and download WAV.
audionormalHint: Peak normalization from −12 to 0 dBFS across all channels; default −1 dBFS. This is not perceptual loudness normalization. Silent audio stays silent.
audioLimits: Browser-supported complete audio files only (codec support varies). At most 20 MiB each / 40 MiB total; 120 decoded seconds total, mono or stereo. Resampled to 44.1 kHz and exported as 16-bit PCM WAV without metadata. Files stay local.
audioInvalid: Check audio codec support, file/duration/channel limits and settings. Use complete, unencrypted audio files.
primecheckDesc: Check whether a whole number is prime.
primecheckHint: Exact result for decimal integers from 0 to 1 trillion. No decimal separators or exponents. 0 and 1 are not prime.
factorizeDesc: Write a number as a product of prime powers.
factorizeHint: Exact factorization for decimal integers from 2 to 1 trillion. The ^ symbol means exponent. No decimal separators or exponents in the input.
gcdlcmDesc: Find the greatest common divisor and least common multiple.
gcdlcmHint: Two signed decimal integers, up to 100 digits each. Results use absolute values and exact integer arithmetic. Convention: GCD(0,0)=0; LCM is 0 if either input is 0.
ipv4subnetDesc: Find the network, mask and address range from CIDR.
ipv4subnetHint: Enter dotted-decimal IPv4/prefix, from /0 to /32. Leading-zero octets are rejected. /31 treats both addresses as point-to-point hosts; /32 has one address and no broadcast. Host counts are theoretical and do not prove routability or availability. No network requests.
ipv6formatDesc: Convert IPv6 to expanded and compact notation.
ipv6formatHint: Accepts hex IPv6 with optional :: and an IPv4 dotted-decimal tail. No brackets, ports or zone IDs. Uses lowercase and the first longest zero run (at least two groups). IPv4-mapped addresses use a dotted-decimal tail in compact output. No network requests.
cidrcheckDesc: Check whether an IPv4 or IPv6 address belongs to a range.
cidrcheckHint: IP and CIDR must use the same address family. Host bits in the range are normalized to the network. Supports /0–32 for IPv4 and /0–128 for IPv6; rejects brackets, zones and ports. This is a local numeric check, not a connectivity test.
cidrInside: The IP is inside this range.
cidrOutside: The IP is outside this range.
mathNetInvalid: Check the integer limits, IP notation, prefix and address family.
anagramDesc: Check whether two texts contain the same character groups.
anagramHint: Up to 100,000 characters per text. Uses Unicode NFC and visible character groups. Optional lowercase conversion follows the page language; accents are retained. Filtering keeps letters, numbers and combining marks. Identical texts also match. Empty filtered text is rejected.
palindromeDesc: Check whether text reads the same forward and backward.
palindromeHint: Up to 100,000 characters. Compares visible character groups with Unicode NFC, keeping accents. Optional lowercase conversion follows the page language; filtering removes everything except letters, numbers and combining marks. Empty filtered text is rejected.
emailextractDesc: Find email-like addresses in a text and copy the list.
emailextractHint: Up to 100,000 characters, 5,000 @ candidates and 1,000 results. Practical ASCII/punycode extraction, not full RFC validation; quoted and internationalized local parts are unsupported. Domains are lowercased; local-part case is retained. Keeps first-seen order. No delivery check or network requests. Limit overflow returns no partial list.
checkLower: Convert to lowercase using the page language
checkLetters: Keep only letters, numbers and combining marks
palindromeNo: The text is not a palindrome.
textCheckInvalid: Check the input and limits. Comparison text must not be empty after filtering; the browser must support Unicode segmentation.
fileHashDesc: Calculate a file’s original byte digest locally and compare it with a supplied digest. A match is not a safety guarantee.
fileHashLimits: One file, up to 50 MiB. Empty files are valid; the entire file is loaded into memory.
fileHashInvalidExpected: The expected digest must contain exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
fileHashInvalidFile: Choose one file up to 50 MiB.
fileHashFailed: Could not complete the operation. Use a current browser with Web Crypto support and HTTPS.
loremDesc: Create Latin placeholder text for layouts with an exact paragraph and word count, generated locally.
loremLimits: 1–50 paragraphs, 5–200 words each; at most 10,000 words. Output is Latin placeholder text, regardless of interface language.
loremInvalid: Enter whole numbers: 1–50 paragraphs and 5–200 words per paragraph.
romanDesc: Convert whole numbers 1–3999 to Roman numerals and back locally.
romanLimits: Integers 1–3999; standard Roman numerals I–MMMCMXCIX. Up to 100 input characters. ASCII digits/letters only; lowercase accepted.
romanInvalid: Enter an integer 1–3999 or a valid standard Roman numeral in the selected direction. Up to 100 characters; no signs, fractions or overlines.
morseDesc: Convert letters A–Z and digits 0–9 to Morse code and back locally.
morseLimits: Text: up to 1000 characters, A–Z and 0–9 only. Morse: up to 6000 characters. Separate letters with spaces and words with /. Decoded text is uppercase.
morseInvalid: Check the direction, supported characters and limits: 1000 text characters, 6000 Morse characters. Use spaces between letter codes and / between words.
